name: FLUX2-dev
description: Development split of the FLUX2 benchmark used to evaluate models that estimate 3D human pose and motion from video. It measures per-frame pose accuracy and temporal consistency, focusing on reconstruction quality of human joints and motion trajectories from monocular video. Typical use includes reporting standard pose error metrics and acceleration/temporal smoothness.
evaluation_method: MPJPE / PA-MPJPE (mean per-joint position error and Procrustes-aligned MPJPE), plus temporal/acceleration errors
reputation: Part of the VIBE-Benchmark suite on Hugging Face and used by researchers in 3D human pose estimation; moderate adoption within that community.
